name: scene3d_patch_cameras
description: Batch-patch existing camera definitions. Use target {x,y,z} to aim a camera; the server derives rotation. Errors on missing id — re-read with scene3d_state. Camera ids are __camera_N__ format. @see guides_get('scene3d')

patch.description: Partial camera fields: label, position, target, rotation, focalLength, aspectRatio, aperture, focalDistance, autoFocus. position, target and focalDistance are world units. Prefer semantic target {x,y,z}; it is converted to rotation and is not persisted.
